title: Mr Thomas Kernan
html_source:
From Section 11: “Mr Kernan, pleased with the order he had booked, walked boldly along James’s street.”

From Section 12: “Mr Kernan halted and preened himself before the sloping mirror of Peter Kennedy, hairdresser. Stylish coat, beyond a doubt.”
